description: This Java class implements a size validator for message commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It ensures that message payloads do not exceed a configured maximum size, and provides a singleton instance for validation.

classes.name: MessageCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractCommandSizeValidator that validates message payload sizes. Implements singleton pattern for instance retrieval.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandSizeValidator, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Creates a new MessagePayloadSizeTooLargeException when payload size exceeds maximum allowed.
